summary: Nuran Wireless Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing amended condensed interim consolidated financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the period ended March 31, 2026, along with certifications. This is a routine regulatory filing to correct or update previous financial disclosures. No transaction, change of control, strategic review, or other special situation event is disclosed. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. It is solely a periodic financial update by a foreign private issuer.
